answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The jetty holds work receipts rather than names, so the voyage of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce. What survives to the bridge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
